raw_response:
```sql
/* Находим школу в штате CA с минимальной широтой (latitude) */
SELECT
    s."city",              /* город */
    f."Low Grade",         /* низшая ступень обучения */
    s."school"             /* название школы */
FROM "schools" AS s
LEFT JOIN "frpm" AS f
    ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE s."state" = 'CA'
  AND s."latitude" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."latitude" ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

```

/* Schools offering a magnet program with K-8 grade span and Multiple Provision Types */
WITH magnet_k8 AS (
    SELECT s."cdscode",
           s."city",
           f."NSLP Provision Status"
    FROM schools s
    JOIN frpm f ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
    WHERE s."magnet" = 1
      AND f."Low Grade" = 'K'
      AND f."High Grade" = '8'
)
SELECT
    /* Number of schools offering Multiple Provision Types among magnet K-8 schools */
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "cdscode")
     FROM magnet_k8
     WHERE "NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types') AS multiple_provision_schools,
    /* Number of distinct cities offering K-8 magnet programs */
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "city") FROM magnet_k8) AS city_count,
    /* Per-city breakdown of schools serving K-8 magnet programs */
    "city",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "cdscode") AS school_count
FROM magnet_k8
GROUP BY "city"
ORDER BY "city";
```

/* Определяем среднюю зарплату (A11) по районам для женщин и находим самую старую женщину-клиента */
WITH female_district_salary AS (
    /* Средняя зарплата по району для женщин-клиентов */
    SELECT
        c."district_id",
        AVG(d."a11") AS avg_salary
    FROM "client" c
    JOIN "district" d ON d."district_id" = c."district_id"
    WHERE c."gender" = 'F'
    GROUP BY c."district_id"
),
oldest_female AS (
    /* Самая старая женщина-клиент (наименьшая дата рождения) */
    SELECT
        c."client_id",
        c."district_id",
        c."birth_date"
    FROM "client" c
    WHERE c."gender" = 'F'
    ORDER BY c."birth_date" ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
lowest_avg AS (
    /* Наименьшая средняя зарплата среди районов женщин */
    SELECT MIN(avg_salary) AS lowest_salary
    FROM female_district_salary
),
highest_avg AS (
    /* Наибольшая средняя зарплата среди районов женщин */
    SELECT MAX(avg_salary) AS highest_salary
    FROM female_district_salary
)
/* Выводим номера счетов самой старой женщины-клиента с наименьшей средней зарплатой и разницу */
SELECT
    a."account_id" AS account_number,
    (SELECT highest_salary FROM highest_avg) - (SELECT lowest_salary FROM lowest_avg) AS salary_gap
FROM "account" a
JOIN "disp" dp ON dp."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "oldest_female" of ON of."client_id" = dp."client_id"
JOIN "female_district_salary" fds ON fds."district_id" = of."district_id"
WHERE dp."type" = 'OWNER'
  AND fds.avg_salary = (SELECT lowest_salary FROM lowest_avg);
```

FROM yearly;

/* Находим самую старую карту с редкостью 'mythic' по originalreleasedate */
WITH oldest_mythic AS (
    SELECT
        c."uuid",
        c."name",
        c."originalreleasedate",
        c."rarity"
    FROM "cards" c
    WHERE LOWER(c."rarity") = 'mythic'
      AND c."originalreleasedate" IS NOT NULL
      AND c."originalreleasedate" <> ''

SELECT
    om."name"                AS card_name,
    om."originalreleasedate" AS release_date,
    l."format"               AS legal_format
FROM oldest_mythic om
LEFT JOIN "legalities" l
       ON l."uuid" = om."uuid"
      AND LOWER(l."status") = 'legal'
ORDER BY l."format";
```

/* Считаем количество бейджей 'Student' за 2010 и 2011 годы и их процентную разницу */
WITH yearly AS (

        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp) AS yr,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM "badges"
    WHERE "name" = 'Student'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp) IN (2010, 2011)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "date"::timestamp)
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2010 THEN cnt END), 0) AS cnt_2010,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN yr = 2011 THEN cnt END), 0) AS cnt_2011,
        SUM(cnt) AS total_cnt
    FROM yearly
)
SELECT
    cnt_2010,
    cnt_2011,
    total_cnt,
    /* процентная разница: (доля 2010 - доля 2011) * 100 */
    ( (cnt_2010::numeric / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0)) * 100
      - (cnt_2011::numeric / NULLIF(total_cnt, 0)) * 100 ) AS percentage_difference
FROM totals;
```

/* Определяем пользователя с максимальной репутацией (наиболее влиятельного) */

    SELECT "id"
    FROM "users"
    ORDER BY "reputation" DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
/* Считаем общее количество постов и количество постов со score > 50 для этого пользователя */
post_stats AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_posts,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "score" > 50) AS posts_above_50
    FROM "posts" p
    JOIN most_influential mi ON p."owneruserid" = mi."id"
)

    CASE
        WHEN total_posts = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (posts_above_50::numeric / total_posts) * 100
    END AS percentage
FROM post_stats;
```

WITH total AS (

    FROM "superhero" s

    SELECT COUNT(*)::numeric AS cnt
    FROM "superhero" s
    JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
    WHERE a."alignment" = 'Bad'
),

    FROM "superhero" s
    JOIN "alignment" a ON s."alignment_id" = a."id"
    JOIN "publisher" p ON s."publisher_id" = p."id"
    WHERE a."alignment" = 'Bad'
      AND p."publisher_name" = 'Marvel Comics'
)
/* Процент супергероев с alignment = 'Bad' и их количество у Marvel Comics */
SELECT
    (bt.cnt / t.cnt) * 100 AS bad_percentage,
    bm.cnt AS bad_marvel_count
FROM total t
CROSS JOIN bad_total bt
CROSS JOIN bad_marvel bm;
```

    tc.total_price,
    tc.total_amount,
    tc.avg_price_per_item
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = tc."customerid";
```

    SELECT
        c."segment" AS segment,
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM "yearmonth" ym

        SUM(CASE WHEN year = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM consumption_by_year

),
